{{Quote|Hi, Dad. I'm back. Here's the evening faxsplat. By the way, feel free to ask me to run errands for you any time you want &hellip;|Prestor to his father|<ref name="Galladinium's Fantastic Technology">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>}}
A '''faxsplat''' was a publication that had an evening edition. [[Prestor]] fetched an evening faxsplat for his father after the latter let him use his [[Hyperfoil 1000-XTC]].
